title: Sort aisles alphabetically in the AddItemSheet picker
description: In AddItemSheet.swift, sort catalog.aisles by localised case-insensitive comparison before iterating in the picker ForEach. Sorting happens in the view only; the catalog's aisles array declaration order is not changed. The nil-tag 'Other' option remains anchored at the bottom of the picker.
acceptance_criteria: Aisle picker shows aisles in A→Z localised case-insensitive order (Bakery, Canned, Cheese, Dairy, …)
'Other' option remains the last entry in the picker
catalog.aisles array order is unchanged; sort applied in view only
Selected aisle writes the original lowercase value from aisle.conf into the file heading

handoff_summary.completed: Applied localised case-insensitive sort to catalog.aisles in the picker ForEach. Single-line change at AddItemSheet.swift:27.
handoff_summary.risks: None — pure view-layer sort, no model changes.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify aisle picker order in the simulator.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflict risk — single-line change to a view file with no other in-flight beads touching AddItemSheet.swift.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare` rather than `<` to ensure locale-aware ordering consistent with the acceptance criteria.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should confirm rendered order matches A→Z and "Other" is last.

conflict_risks: No conflict risk — single-line change to a view file with no other in-flight beads touching AddItemSheet.swift.

execution_history.summary: Sorted the aisle picker in AddItemSheet.swift by applying `.sorted { $0.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1) == .orderedAscending }` inline on `catalog.aisles` inside the ForEach. The "Other" option remains anchored at the bottom. No model layer was touched.
